scope.documents: SysML 2.0 Part 1: Language and KerML 1.0, including their normative abstract-syntax XMI, ten library archives and three JSON schemas.
scope.currentProduct: Read-only textual model analysis and structural viewing with a reusable kernel.
scope.longTermTarget: Qualify the complete language kernel; decide editing, normative interchange, execution and graphical tool-conformance claims separately.
scope.sourcePrecedence: Clause 2 in each specification gives its normative machine-readable files precedence if they conflict with the PDF.
scope.denominator: Source units overlap: clauses contain productions, constraints and prose candidates. Their counts cannot be added into a requirements-coverage denominator.
scope.closure: An individual requirement can be qualified only after its obligations are decomposed, applicable cases and boundaries are reviewed, implementation/API evidence is current, and linked positive/negative checks pass. Parent clauses never inherit a passing status from a child.

graph.role: candidate upstream graph and resolution implementation; presence does not prove every rule

diagram.role: current structural overview; not complete normative graphical notation

cardinality.role: Exact checked cardinality adapter; unknown is never a default

alias-validation.role: Plain alias distinguishability against owned and inherited memberships

foundation-tests.role: Contract regressions, complete import-predicate input partitions and bundled-library syntax sweep

syntax-structure.role: Patched syntax structure checker; KERNEL-002 defers alias metaclass comparisons until resolution

checked-featuring.role: Audited package AttributeUsage domain; checked ownership and featuring relationships, with variable/variation and malformed-evidence exclusions.

checked-model-level.role: Bounded eligibility proof; package attribute support does not qualify every expression family.

checked-invocation.role: Checked canonical callee/input/argument identity mapping; requires current shared publication and retains incomplete-provider failures.

checked-bound-expressions.role: Checked operand/wrapper certification, Boolean branch selection and retained unknown boundaries; includes private conditional proof regressions.

checked-bound-execution.role: Bounded exact execution over certified identities; conditional branches preserve Boolean typing and lazy evaluation.

import-api.role: Checked import closure and contextual visibility with bounded queries and explicit failures.

checked-imports.role: Checked import closure, collision pruning and bounded Package filter proof.

import-tests.role: Native import identity, visibility, unknown-provider and malformed-transport regressions.

checked-dynamic-isolation.role: Checked localization of canonical unresolved classifier specializations; preserves dependent qualifications, identity, ownership, revision and work guards.

isolation-tests.role: Independent exact bounds and direct/transitive unknown providers, within one file and in either cross-file order.

checked-eligibility-batch.role: Query-local reuse of checked topology, TypeRelations and callee signatures, with fresh path-sensitive eligibility and supplied-binding proofs, semantic stamps, cumulative work and partial-certificate guards.

cold-query-tests.role: First direct range, alias and repeated-endpoint queries over all 94 library sources, with and without an unrelated missing base; each case rebuilds the canonical model and publishes implied relationships before the first proof.

ordered-predicate-tests.role: Exact ordering truth tables, integer/rational precision and rejected operand/endpoint regressions through the public snapshot query after JSON round trip.

predicate-tests.role: Scalar equality, exact Boolean truth tables, eager/deferred operand evaluation and explicit unknown values through the public query after JSON round trip.

coalescing-tests.role: native round-trip empty/present/null-coalescing values and guarded unknown endpoints

checked-prefix-reuse.role: same-transaction static prefix avoids unused name materialization; physical authority and complete recipe checks remain required

empty-comparison-tests.role: Native round-trip empty/scalar equality and sameness with explicit unknown operands and endpoint guards.

atomic-dynamic-staging.role: Complete row preparation before atomic ownership append; late failure preserves independently staged result-family ownership.

atomic-ownership-batch.role: Bounded all-or-nothing registration, with prior-view preservation and equivalence to individual registration tests.

assessments.obligation: Expose owned, inherited and checked imported membership identities, alias long/short names, declared/contextual visibility and target status without rewriting element ownership.
assessments.limits: Schema 3 exposes explicit owned/inherited bindings and checked imported closure with contextual visibility, ordered identities and explicit unknown results. Missing endpoints, incomplete Type providers, inline filters and syntax recovery do not certify empty closure. General metadata/filter predicates, all contextual resolution, implicit construction and complete metamodel traversal remain open. Complete results certify this bounded query, not whole-model validity.

assessments.obligation: Expose evaluated expression-valued bounds with explicit completeness.
assessments.limits: Static package providers support checked arithmetic and conditionals with Boolean literals, references and nested tests. MULT-016 now passes; selected branches preserve exact bounds and unselected unbound/undefined values are not executed. Unavailable or non-Boolean conditions, invalid selected values, recursive/ineligible branches and shadowed designated operators remain unknown. General value equality, other control operators, direct function execution and all contextual/evaluation semantics remain unqualified. MULT-020/021 retain independent exact arithmetic and conditional bounds alongside unresolved classifier bases; direct and transitive dependents remain incomplete. Malformed relationship evidence, dependent dynamic families and other unqualified configurations can still prevent shared publication. This is bounded proof isolation, not complete execution or general incremental analysis. MULT-022/023 qualify combined arithmetic/conditional range endpoints, aliases, repeated providers and invalid endpoints using checked evidence shared within one query. KERNEL-006 qualifies first direct range, alias and repeated-endpoint queries over the full pinned library after implied relationships are published, without preceding proof queries. Callee signatures share checked evidence; every supplied binding is rechecked. Other cold entry paths and more complex expressions can still exhaust the unchanged allowance; reuse does not qualify every composition or a global cache. KERNEL-007 adds finite exact numeric <, <=, > and >= predicates, with designated function identity and checked positional evidence. MULT-024/025 cover each relation, large integers, exact rationals, aliases, nested/lazy selection and refused operands/endpoints. Approximate real, infinity, quantity, string, sequence and general function comparisons remain unqualified. Arithmetic intermediates can exceed i128 through exact rationals; exported bounds retain the signed-128-bit limit. KERNEL-008 adds equality/sameness (==, !=, ===, !==) for Boolean pairs or finite exact numeric pairs, eager Boolean not/xor/&/| and conditional and/or/implies. All deferred operands retain complete model-level eligibility and reciprocal wrapper evidence; only required values are executed. MULT-026/027/028 cover exact scalar values, all Boolean truth tables, eager versus skipped unavailable values, nested expressions and negative operand/endpoint guards. Cross-domain Boolean/numeric equality, nonempty sequence/string/occurrence values, quantities, approximate numbers and general function dispatch remain unqualified. This is a bounded provider execution certificate, not whole-model type validity. KERNEL-009 adds explicit empty NullExpression values and lazy ?? over the admitted exact scalar domain. MULT-029/030 distinguish null and () from zero, Boolean false, unavailable providers and execution failure, and cover nested composition, aliases, skipped/selected operands and numeric endpoint restrictions. Every operand still requires eligibility and reciprocal deferred-wrapper proof. Approximate arithmetic results, including exponent overflow to infinity and underflow to zero, are refused. Null is an intermediate value, not a numeric endpoint or absence certificate. The combined old/new workspace and unresolved-import variant retain their earlier assertions. Same-transaction static-prefix reuse skips an unused library-name rebuild while preserving physical-authority and recipe checks and the unchanged work allowance. Larger compositions may still exhaust that allowance. KERNEL-010 adds ==, !=, === and !== for explicit empty pairs and empty versus admitted Boolean or exact numeric scalars, with both operands successfully executed before comparison. MULT-031/032 qualify both operand orders, aliases and coalescing/conditional/logical composition, preserving unknown for unavailable operands, failures, unsupported domains and invalid endpoints. Two earlier null-equality expectations now correctly evaluate to 7. Empty comparison does not certify occurrence identity, general sequence equality or whole-model type validity. Dynamic staging prepares all rows before atomic ownership registration and reuses the private result-family ownership view; it no longer clones the complete prefix twice. Late invalid owners, identity changes and exhausted budgets leave the prior view intact. The full integration corpus remains combined and the work allowance is unchanged.
